_comment: How ground that gives way under itself climbs the tiers (design 5.2).
What it asks of a player is to read the floor, and three seconds of unmistakable fracture is a long time
to get off a piece of ground. Two dials: `size` is how much ground one collapse takes, and `speed` how
fast it goes once the warning is over. Neither buys the warning: a collapse that arrived unannounced would
not be a harder version of this, it would be a different and worse thing.
Not the same as `collapse`, which tears the world floor and ends the Age. This one only ever takes the
hillside you are standing on -- but given long enough it takes every hillside, which is an Age undone as
surely as a torn floor. So it is failing, with `collapse` (Jonah, 2026-09-17).
